purpose: Measure a consented public scheduling handoff for non-personalized Google Ads attribution
eventScope: The application emits only simplepractice_exit as an acquisition event. Standard GA4 automatic events and first-visit/session markers are separately included in this unapproved flow for review.
disabledAutomaticCollection: enhanced measurement including history pageviews, outbound clicks, forms, search, scroll, downloads and video
meaning: An intentional new-client navigation to SimplePractice; not an appointment request, appointment, attendance, client acquisition or revenue
runtime: One main-page Google tag, loaded only after a fresh advertising-measurement choice on an explicitly reviewed route

observedRuntimeDestinations.https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js: The existing property's public Google tag; the browser discloses ordinary request metadata when loading it
observedRuntimeDestinations.https://analytics.google.com/g/collect: GA4 events, consent, client/session identifiers, canonical location with permitted click identifiers, fixed GA4 title, empty GA4 referrer and browser metadata
observedRuntimeDestinations.https://www.google-analytics.com/g/colle: Documented GA4 collector, subject to the same reviewed envelope
observedRuntimeDestinations.https://region1.google-analytics.com/g/c: Regional GA4 collector, subject to the same reviewed envelope
observedRuntimeDestinations.https://www.google.com/measurement/conve: Native Ads-linked GA4 measurement; includes event and advertising identifiers, canonical URL, actual reviewed document title in tiba, consent and browser metadata
observedRuntimeDestinations.https://stats.g.doubleclick.net/g/collec: Native identifier/consent ping observed without an event name; still a disclosure to Google
observedRuntimeDestinations.https://www.googletagmanager.com/a: Sampled Google tag diagnostics observed in an isolated probe; protocol and tag metadata, not a separate application conversion

googleVisibleContext: The generic scheduling-handoff event and M.F.T. site/account identity
The exact reviewed public route with only permitted advertising context
A fixed GA4 page_title and empty page_referrer; the linked Google measurement request also reads one of the two exact reviewed actual document titles
Google's pseudonymous client, session and advertising identifiers
Standard first_visit/session_start metadata and user_engagement, separate from the handoff acquisition event
Google protocol and consent fields, request time, IP transport and browser metadata
Pre-existing Google/DoubleClick cookies may be accessible when advertising storage is granted, subject to browser restrictions
excludedData: Page text or any title other than the two exact reviewed public document titles

retentionBoundary.websiteContext: Fixed 30-minute usable consented context, without renewal on navigation; refusal, withdrawal and GPC/DNT stop collection. Cleanup runs on active page enforcement and the next controlled page load; a closed or suspended browser cannot run JavaScript deletion at a guaranteed wall-clock time
retentionBoundary.firstPartyVendorCookies: The intercepted runtime created host-only mftga_* cookies expiring within the original 30-minute permission window; this is version-specific evidence, not a guarantee about every Google cookie
retentionBoundary.vendorLocalStorage: The tag also uses _gcl_ls on this origin; it must be cleared with expired or withdrawn measurement state and before a new unrelated permission window, with no use of stale context
retentionBoundary.thirdPartyVendorCookies: Existing Google/DoubleClick cookies are outside website control and may be accessible under advertising consent; their storage lifetime is not limited by the website's 30-minute setting
retentionBoundary.ga4EventDataLastReported: 2 months; previous draft's account readback, not freshly verified by this release
retentionBoundary.ga4UserDataLastReported: 14 months with reset on new user activity enabled; previous draft's account readback, not freshly verified by this release
retentionBoundary.ga4RequiredBeforeActivation: Verify user/event retention at 2 months and reset on new activity OFF; this is proposed, not an account change made by this release
retentionBoundary.googleAdsClickThroughWindowLastReported: 90 days; this is an attribution window, not a deletion guarantee
retentionBoundary.googleAggregateReports: Not governed by the GA4 event/user retention setting
retentionBoundary.googleAdsRetention: Separate Google Ads terms apply, including published log anonymization periods and exceptions; the website cannot impose its 30-minute browser limit on recipient storage

activationRequirements: A documented determination that this entire event, identifier and context combination is permitted by Google's sensitive-information rule and applicable practice obligations
Recorded review of the exact routes, payload, recipients and their retention
Reverify the exact GA4-Ads link, primary/secondary and campaign goals, disabled advertising features, enhanced measurement and required retention settings in the intended accounts
Intercepted actual-runtime evidence for automatic collection, cookies, consent and fixed local expiry
The exact document titles must match at build and runtime; any title, route, form or payload change requires reassessment of automatic vendor collection
Reviewed policy with matching flow and runtime hashes, plus the production build flag
